liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (3 reviews): Singled out as the one standout of an otherwise lackluster, dry first set; Seen as potentially the best song of the first set, though it should not be [8][11][18]
- **Lazy River Road** (2 reviews): Garcia's fingerpicked solo was remembered as particularly bad; Said to plod vacantly without direction [15][18]
- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): Garcia missed a cue returning from one of the solos; Jerry took essentially no solo while David Murray went wild on sax [15][17]
- **Let the Good Times Roll** (1 review): Listener found this version listless and lifeless, missing Brent's voice [11]
- **Mama Tried** (1 review): Reviewer in the last row thought it the standout of a very poor first set [9]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Even this stumbles on what the reviewer calls an off night [18]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer especially likes this one, and finds the jamming after Space strong [10]
- **Drums** (1 review): Little jamming after Eyes into Drums; the hoped-for psychedelia with Sikiru did not arrive [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mardi Gras Parade / Drums**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-02-26.akg.flaschner.91244.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 184 min [1]
- **gd1995-02-26.144290.sbd.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 178 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1995-02-26.aud.seff.4778.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 182 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Some digital noise in the first minutes of Parade Drums; levels run high during part of Drums/Space [3]
- **gd95-02-26.aud.5495.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 182 min; rated 3.2/5 by 10 [4]
- **gd1995-02-26.sbd.monitor.mix.miller.109244.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 1.78/5 by 9 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard monitor mix; Vince's vocals are rough in the first set and on Iko Iko [17]

## Around the show

- Mardi Gras night, third of a run, with special guests; David Murray's saxophone struck this listener as shrill and manic [8]
- Jerry seemed tired to a first-time attendee; the Mardi Gras parade was a surprise and spectacular [12]
- Listener got tickets from a float on the floor, needing a password to get down there [14]
- Seated in a wheelchair before Jerry, listener saw him nodding off and bumping the mic [19]
- After the parade Jerry revived and smiled, trading lyrics with the listener at the end of NFA [19]
- Weir played acoustic on Mama Tried, Mexicali Blues and Don't Ease Me In [1]
- David Murray played sax on Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World [1]
- Sikiru Adepoju played talking drums for the parade and Space through Days Between [1]
- Called the most interesting Not Fade Away since Hornsby left the band [9]
- A small letdown, like other big nights the band often blew [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-02-26.akg.flaschner.91244.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Chris Davis; source: AKG 460b/ck61 -> custom pre-amp -> D-7 [1]
- **gd1995-02-26.144290.sbd.miller.clugston.flac1644**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Dat > 1st generation cassettes > Dat > HDD (.wav 16-bit/44.1kHz) [2]. Also: Soundboard from Charlie Miller's effort, with a four-second AKG 460 patch from Flaschner and Davis in Eyes; not the monitor mix [2]
- **gd1995-02-26.aud.seff.4778.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Unknown Mics > DAT @48k [3]. Also: Audience source tracked to fit three discs, with fades only at set starts and ends [3]
- **gd95-02-26.aud.5495.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff and Chris L.; source: Audience [4]. Also: Audience recording from unknown mics to DAT, a shntool-fixed version of an earlier shn set [4]
- **gd1995-02-26.sbd.monitor.mix.miller.109244.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Monitor Mix -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Cassette [7]
